en.name: Cave of the Seven Sleepers
description:
The Cave of the Seven Sleepers is situated in the village of Rajib, southeast of Amman, dug on a hillside replete with late Roman and Byzantine tombs of the *arcosolia-loculi type*. The tale of the Seven Sleepers is known around the world and mentioned in Syriac, Latin, Greek and Arabic sources. It is a pious story of Christian youths persecuted by a pagan Roman emperor for their faith and saved from death by being put into a long sleep, which lasted for centuries (309 years, according to Muslim tradition). When they awoke, the world around them had become firmly Christian. Their miraculous appearance presented proof of God’s ability to resurrect both the soul and the body. Islam came to share the same Christian parable of faith and devotion, for the same story forms the text of one of the chapters (*Suras*) of the *Qur’an* (*Qur’an* XVIII: *Sura* of the cave). It reads, *“Or dost thou think the Men of the Cave and al-Raqim were among our signs a wonder? When the youths took refuge in the cave saying, ‘Our Lord, give us mercy from thee, and furnish us with rectitude in our affair’. Then we smote their ears many years in the Cave”*  
In the early 6th century, a small church was built over the cave which was later converted into a mosque. The column bases in the nave of the church are still evident, although the mosque entrance was made in the east at the apse. Another mosque was built in the area in front of the cave entrance. This area was enclosed and a *mihrab* was incorporated into the south wall. This mosque underwent several reconstructions including one dated 277/ 890-891. The cave is entered through a narrow doorway and three steps carved out of the rock. Above the doorway are five medallions the central one showing a Greek cross. On each side of the entrance there are semi-engaged columns, a capital and a scalloped niche. Inside the cave are two arched recesses with three sarcophagi in each. The sarcophagi are decorated in high relief carved with motifs of intersecting squares, which form eight-pointed stars, as well as egg-and-dart and bead-and-reel patterns.

es.name: Cueva de los Siete Durmientes
description:
La Cueva de los Siete Durmientes se encuentra en el pueblo de Rayib, al sureste de Ammán, un asentamiento excavado en la falda de una colina repleta de tumbas tardorromanas y bizantinas del tipo *arcosolia loculi*. El cuento de los Siete Durmientes, conocido en todo el mundo, aparece mencionado en fuentes sirias, latinas, griegas y romanas. Se trata de una historia piadosa en la que unos jóvenes cristianos, perseguidos por un emperador romano pagano a causa de su fe, son salvados de la muerte al sumirse en un largo sueño que dura siglos (309 años, según la tradición musulmana). Cuando se despiertan, el mundo a su alrededor se ha convertido en profundamente cristiano. Su aparición milagrosa se ofrece como prueba de la capacidad de Dios de resucitar tanto el alma como el cuerpo. El Islam llegó a compartir esta misma parábola sobre la fe y la devoción, ya que el relato forma parte de uno de los capítulos (*Azoras*) del Corán (Corán XVIII: *Azora* de la caverna), en el que se dice: “¿O acaso piensas que los Hombres de la Caverna y al-Raqim constituyen una maravilla entre Nuestros signos? Cuando los jóvenes buscaron refugio en la caverna diciendo: ‘Señor, apiádate de nosotros y llénanos de rectitud en nuestro proceder’, Nosotros los hicimos dormir durante muchos años en la Caverna”.  
A principios del siglo VI se construyó sobre la caverna una capilla que posteriormente fue reconvertida en mezquita. Aún se pueden contemplar las basas de los pilares de la nave de la iglesia, aunque la entrada a la mezquita se abrió por el este, en el lugar donde había estado el ábside. En la zona que se extiende ante la entrada a la caverna se construyó otra mezquita, encerrando dicha zona en un recinto y añadiendo un *mihrab* en el muro sur. Esta mezquita experimentó sucesivas reconstrucciones, incluida una en el año 277/890-891. Se accede a la caverna a través de una entrada angosta y de tres escalones tallados en la roca. Encima de esta entrada se pueden contemplar cinco medallones, el central de los cuales muestra una cruz griega. A cada lado de la entrada se alzan sendas columnas semiadosadas con un capitel y un nicho festoneado. En el interior de la caverna, hay dos retranqueos abovedados, con tres sarcófagos dentro de cada uno de ellos. Los relieves que recubren estos sarcófagos representan cuadrados entrelazados que forman estrellas de ocho puntas, así como bandas ornamentales de ovas y flechas, y motivos decorativos de contarios y junquillos.

fr.name: La grotte des Sept Dormants
description:
La grotte des Sept Dormants se trouve dans le village de Rajib, au sud-est d’Amman. Elle s’enfonce à l’intérieur d’une colline qui est un lieu particulièrement riche en tombes romaines tardives et byzantines du type *arcosolia-loculi*.  
L’histoire des Sept Dormants, connue dans le monde entier, est rapportée dans des sources syriaques, latines, grecques et arabes. Il s’agit de l’histoire édifiante de jeunes chrétiens persécutés par un empereur romain et païen. Ils n’échapperont à la mort qu’en restant plongés dans un long sommeil qui va durer des siècles (trois cent neuf ans, selon la tradition musulmane). Ils vont se réveiller dans un monde de triomphe du christianisme. Leur réapparition miraculeuse symbolise le pouvoir divin de résurrection de l’âme et du corps. Cette parabole de foi et de dévotion est commune aux chrétiens et à l’islam; elle fait même l’objet d’une des sourates du Coran (Coran XVIII: *Sourate* de la Caverne):  
9- “*…Tiendras-tu (l’aventure) des compagnons de la caverne et de l’épitaphe pour un prodige d’entre Nos signes ?  
10- Lors ces jeunes hommes se réfugièrent dans la caverne et dirent: ‘Notre Seigneur, accordenous une miséricorde de ton sein, ménage-nous de notre chef rectitude’.  
Nous assourdîmes leurs oreilles dans la caverne pendant des années en nombre*”.  
Au début du VIe siècle, une petite église est construite au-dessus de la grotte; elle sera réaménagée ultérieurement en mosquée. Les bases des colonnes de la nef chrétienne ont été conservées. Par contre, l’entrée de la mosquée a été déplacée à l’est, où se trouvait l’abside. Une seconde mosquée a été construite juste en face de l’entrée de la grotte: on a érigé des murs tout autour et adjoint un *mihrab* côté sud. Cette mosquée a été reconstruite à plusieurs reprises, en particulier en 277/890-91. On accède à la grotte par une porte étroite et trois marches creusées dans la roche. On remarque sur le linteau cinq médaillons, dont celui du centre qui porte une croix grecque. L’entrée répartit de chaque côté de la porte des colonnes engagées, un chapiteau et une niche à coquille. En pénétrant dans la grotte, on voit deux voûtes en renfoncement, chacune contenant trois sarcophages. Les décors des hauts-reliefs des sarcophages sont composés de godrons, de chapelets et d’étoiles à huit pointes formées par des entrelacs de carrés.

en.name: Church of São Tiago
description: The Church of São Tiago is in the enclosed part of the Old Town. Gothic in style, it was further added to in the reign of D. Manuel I.A former commandery of the Order of Santiago, it is of considerable interest as a construction, primarily the vaulting of the nave with its brick ribs. In fact, brick is used for most of the building, in an art that almost only appears in the southern third of the country. A memorial stone, dated 1511, and decorated with the National coat of arms, is dedicated to Francisco Frazão, magistrate, almost certainly indicating when the church was restored.

ar.name: خان أغزيقارة (نزل).
description:
يتألف نزل أغزيقارة من فناء مفتوح وقسم مسقوف، ويعتبر مثالاً هاماً عن النزُل ذات الأفنية في عهد سلاجقة الأناضول. والمواد الأساسية المستخدمة في المبنى هي كسارة الحجارة المثبتة بالملاط، بينما الجدران بكاملها والدعامات والأقواس والقناطر والدعامات الجسرية مكسوّة بالحجر الصقيل المزيَّن. وجرى تدعيم أبراج الزوايا والجدران السميكة العالية بدعامات. أما المستويات العليا للواجهات ففيها نوافذ على شكل فتحات مستطيلة (كالطلاَّقات). تمَّ تركيب سبيلي ماء متعاكسين في الجدار الغربي للفناء الذي يمكن الدخول إليه عبر باب من جهة الشمال.  
  
صمِّم الفناء على شكل مربع تقريباً، ويتألف من إيوانات. فالجزء الغربي من إيوان المدخل وأحد أقسام الجانب الغربي أيضاً لهما أروقة مزدوجة، أما الجانب الجنوبي والقسم الجنوبي من الجدار الغربي فيتألفان من غرف مسقوفة. وفي وسط الجانب الشرقي للفناء ثمة مدخل يؤدي إلى القسم المغطَّى.  
  
يوجد في وسط الفناء مبنى لمسجد مفتوح يقع فوق مظلة مربعة الشكل ومؤلفة من أربع دعامات متصلة ببعضها بعضاً بواسطة قناطر مدببة. ويمكن الدخول إلى المسجد عبر سلّمين من جهته الشرقية. ونرى داخل المسجد فسحة مربعة الشكل أبعادها 4X4 أمتار مربعة، تعلوها قبة تنتصب فوق كوّات مزخرفة بمقرنصات. يقال إن سبيل ماء كان موجوداً في الأسفل، ولكن لم يعد له وجود الآن.  
  
إن القسم المسقوف للنزل مستطيل الشكل، أو مربع تقريباً، يتألف من ممر باتجاه شرق- غرب تحيط به ستة أجنحة مقنطرة ومتعامدة ممتدة من الشمال إلى الجنوب، والقبة التي تعلو الجناح الرئيسي تشبه قبة المسجد، وتحملها كوّات مزخرفة بمقرنصات. أما البابان الداخلي والخارجي لنزل أغزيقارة فيبديان تشابهات في التصميم والتزيين حيث زُخرفا بأشكال هندسية. وتشاهَد على محراب المسجد المفتوح حلي متجانسة. وفي حين أن نُزُل سلاجقة الأناضول تحتوي على أبواب مداخل موازية للأفنية والأقسام المسقوفة القائمة على المحور ذاته، فقد وُضع باب الفناء في هذا المبنى بشكل جانبي. ويعتبر المبنى والمسجد وفنائه نماذج نادرة وغير مألوفة في فن العمارة الأناضولية.
dates: القسم المغطَّى: شعبان 628 / حزيران 1231؛ الفناء: شعبان 637 /  شباط 1240.
keywords: تجارة؛ زخرفة هندسية؛ خان؛ عهد سلاجقة الأناضول؛ مسجد مفتوح؛ نزل.

en.name: Ağzıkara Han (caravanserai).
description:
Ağzıkara Han, which consists of an open courtyard and a covered section, is an important example of the caravanserais with a courtyard from the Anatolian Seljuq period. The building's core structure is of rubble bound with mortar, while the entirety of its walls, buttresses, vaults, arches and piers are faced with fine, dressed stone. The corner towers and high, thick walls are supported by buttresses. The upper levels of the façades have slit-like windows (embrasures). The courtyard is entered through a portal on the north side, in whose west wall two fountains have been installed back to back.  
The courtyard has an almost square layout with *iwans*. Both the west part of the entrance-*iwan* and one section of the west side have double porticoes, while the south side and the south section of the west wall have covered rooms. In the middle of the east side of the courtyard is the portal leading into the covered section.  
In the centre of the courtyard is a kiosk\-*masjid*, which sits on top of a square baldachin formed of four piers connected by pointed arches. The *masjid* is accessed by a double staircase on its east side. The interior of the *masjid*, a square plan, measures 4 m x 4 m and is surmounted by a dome rising on squinches decorated with *muqarnas*. A fountain said to have once existed below is no longer extant.  
The covered section of the caravanserai is rectangular, almost square. It has a main aisle running east to west flanked with six vaulted aisles perpendicularly, extending north and south. A lantern dome over the main aisle is, like the dome in the kiosk mosque, supported on squinches filled with *muqarnas*.  
Ağzıkara Han's inner and outer portals show similarities of design and ornament and are decorated with geometric motifs. The *mihrab* of the kiosk-*masjid* also features assorted rosettes.  
While Anatolian Seljuq caravanserais usually have the respective entrance portals to their courtyards and to their covered sections situated on the same axis, in this structure the courtyard portal has been placed off to the side. The building and the *masjid* in its courtyard are rare and unusual examples of Anatolian architecture.

The Ağzıkarahan caravanserai was commissioned by Hoca Mesud in the reign of Sultan Alaaddin Keykubad and is located on the main commercial Konya–Kayseri route in Anatolia that bridges Asia and Europe. An important example of Anatolian Seljuq caravanserais with courtyards, the structure comprises a courtyard and a covered section. It has the look of a stronghold with its thick, high walls reinforced by corner towers and buttresses. This caravanserai is one of the few in Anatolia to have a *masjid* rising on a baldachin in the middle of its open courtyard.
dates: Covered section: hegira Sha‘ban 628 / June 1231; courtyard: hegira Sha‘ban 637 / February 1240.
artist: Hoca Mesud [Mas‘ud], son of Abdullah [‘Abd Allah].
keywords: Anatolian Seljuq; trade; han; caravanserai; kiosk-masjid; geometric decoration

es.name: Han (caravasar) de Ağzıkara
description:
El *han* de Ağzıkara, que consta de un patio y una zona cubierta, es un importante ejemplo de los caravasares con patio del periodo selyuquí de Anatolia. La estructura básica del edificio es de bloques de piedra y argamasa, mientras que las paredes, los contrafuertes, las bóvedas, los arcos y los pilares están revestidos de fina piedra labrada. Las torres de las esquinas y los muros, altos y gruesos, están sustentados por contrafuertes. Los niveles superiores de las fachadas presentan ranuras a modo de saeteras. Se entra al patio por un portal de la fachada norte en cuya pared hay dos fuentes contrapuestas.  
El patio tiene planta casi cuadrada con *iwan*. La parte occidental del *iwan* de entrada y una zona de la parte oeste presentan pórticos dobles, mientras que la parte sur y la zona sur del muro oeste tienen salas cubiertas. La puerta de acceso a la zona cubierta está en medio del lateral oriental del patio.  
En el centro del patio se eleva un pabellón-*masyid* sobre un baldaquín cuadrado formado por cuatro pilares unidos mediante arcos apuntados. Al *masyid* se accede por una escalera doble que está en el lado este. El interior, de 4 × 4 m, está coronado por una cúpula que se alza sobre trompas decoradas con muqarnas. Se dice que, en tiempos, justo debajo hubo una fuente que no se ha conservado.  
La zona cubierta del *han* es rectangular, casi cuadrada. Posee una nave principal orientada de este a oeste, flanqueada perpendicularmente por seis naves abovedadas que se extienden de norte a sur. La cúpula con linterna situada sobre la nave principal, al igual que la bóveda del pabellón, descansa sobre trompas adornadas con muqarnas.  
Los portales exterior e interior muestran similitudes en su diseño y ornamentación, y están decorados con motivos geométricos. El *mihrab del pabellón-masyid también presenta rosetas diversas.  
Los caravasares selyuqíes de Anatolia se caracterizan por tener las entradas a los patios y a las zonas cubiertas situadas en un mismo eje. Sin embargo, en esta estructura, la entrada al patio se encuentra en un lateral. El edificio y el masyid del patio son dos ejemplos singulares dentro de la arquitectura anatolia.*

El caravasar de Ağzıkara fue encargado por Hoca Mesud durante el sultanato de Alaaddin Keykubad. Se encuentra en la principal ruta comercial de Anatolia, la de Konya-Kayseri, que une Asia y Europa. La estructura, con patio y zona cubierta, es un importante ejemplo de los *han* selyuquíes con patio. Tiene aspecto de fortaleza por sus altos y gruesos muros, reforzados por torres en las esquinas y contrafuertes. Este caravasar es uno de los pocos de Anatolia con *masyid*, que se alza sobre un baldaquín en mitad del patio.
dates: Zona cubierta: mes de *shaban* de 628 de la Hégira / junio de 1231 d. C.; patio: *shaban* de 637 / febrero de 1240.
keywords: selyuquíes de Anatolia; comercio; han; caravasar; pabellón-masyid; decoración geométrica.

fr.name: Agzikara Han (caravansérail).
description:
Agzikara Han, qui ne consiste plus aujourd'hui qu'en une cour ouverte et une partie construite couverte, est un important exemple des caravansérails à cour de la période des Seldjoukides d'Anatolie. La construction est essentiellement en pierraille liée au mortier tandis que la totalité des murs, des contreforts, des voûtes, des arcs et des piliers est doublée d'une belle pierre de taille. Le haut des façades est percé de fenêtres étroites. On pénètre dans la cour par un portail ouvert sur la façade nord. Le mur ouest comporte deux fontaines implantées dos-à-dos.  
La cour est de plan pratiquement carré à *iwan*. La partie occidentale de l'*iwan* de l'entrée et une section de la partie ouest sont bordées de portiques doubles, tandis que la partie sud et la section sud du mur ouest servent de soutènement à des salles couvertes. Au milieu du côté est de la cour se dresse un portail d'accès à la partie couverte.  
Au centre de la cour s'élève un kiosque-*masjid* posé sur un baldaquin carré formé de quatre piliers réunis par des arcs brisés. On accède au *masjid* par un double escalier côté est. L'intérieur, de plan carré de 4 x 4 m, est surmonté par une coupole soutenue par des trompes décorées de *mouqarnas*. Une fontaine qui aurait jadis existé juste au-dessous a aujourd'hui disparu.  
La partie couverte est presque carrée. Elle possède une nef principale orientée est-ouest, flanquée de six nefs voûtées perpendiculaires axées nord-sud. La coupole à lanterne de la nef centrale est soutenue par des trompes à *mouqarnas* comme le kiosque de la cour.  
Les faces intérieures et extérieures des portails présentent diverses similarités de dessin et d'ornements et sont décorées de motifs géométriques. Le *mihrab* du kiosque-*masjid* est par ailleurs orné de rosettes.  
Les caravansérails seldjoukides anatoliens se caractérisent habituellement par l'alignement sur un même axe du portail d'accès à la cour et de celui aux parties couvertes. Celui d'Agzikara Han est décalé. Le bâtiment et le *masjid* sont des exemples rares, et originaux, dans l'architecture anatolienne.

Le caravansérail d'Agzikara *han* a été commandité par Hoca Mesud sous le règne du sultan Aladin Keykubad et est situé sur la route anatolienne de Konya à Kayseri, voie commerciale majeure qui relie l'Asie à l'Europe. Important exemple de caravansérail à cour de la période seldjoukide d'Anatolie, la structure comprend une cour et une partie couverte. Le *han* avait l'aspect d'une forteresse avec ses murs hauts et épais renforcés de tours d'angle et de contreforts. C'est l'un des rares en Anatolie à avoir un kiosque-*masjid*construit sur un baldaquin au centre de sa cour ouverte.
dates: Section couverte : chaaban 628 de l’Hégire / juin 1231 J.-C. ; cour : chaaban 637 H / février 1240 J.-C.
keywords: période des Seldjoukides d’Anatolie ; commerce ; han ; caravansérails ; kiosque-masjid ; décoration géométrique

tr.name: Ağzıkara Han.
names: Ribat-ı Hoca Mesud, Kervansaray-i Hoca Mesud, Hoca Mesud Kervansarayı
description:
Açık avlu ile kapalı bölümden oluşan Ağzıkara Han, Anadolu Selçuklu Dönemi avlulu kervansaraylarının önemli örneklerinden biridir. Moloz taşın dolgu malzemesi olarak kullanıldığı yapıda, köşe kuleleri ve payandalarla desteklenen yüksek kalın duvarlar, tonoz olan üst örtü, payeler ve kemerler düzgün kesme taşla kaplanmıştır. Cephelerin üst kesimlerindeki mazgal pencerelerle aydınlanan yapının avlusuna kuzey cephesine yerleştirilmiş taçkapıdan girilir. Taçkapının batısındaki duvarın iç ve dış yüzüne sırt sırta gelecek şekilde, iki çeşme yapılmıştır.  
  
Eyvanlı avlu şemasını sahip kareye yakın planlı avluda, giriş eyvanının batısı ile batı kenarının bir bölümünde çift revak; girişin doğusu ile karşı cepheyi oluşturan güney cephede ve batı cephesinin güney ucunda kapalı mekanlar yer alır. Avlunun doğu cephesi ortasında ise kapalı bölüm taçkapısı bulunur.  
  
Avlunun ortasında, dört ayak ve bunları bağlayan sivri kemerlerle oluşturulmuş kare baldaken üzerine oturtulmuş köşk mescide doğu cephesinde bulunan çift kollu bir merdivenle ulaşılır. İçten 4 m. X 4 m. ölçülere sahip kare planlı mescid, mukarnaslı tromplarla geçilen bir kubbeyle örtülmüştür. Mescidin altında bulunduğu söylenen şadırvan bugün mevcut değildir.  
  
Kareye yakın dikdörtgen planlı kapalı bölüm doğu-batı yönünde uzanan bir ana sahın ile bu sahna kuzey ve güneyden dik uzanan tonozlarla örtülmüş altışar sahından oluşur. Ana sahında bulunan aydınlık kubbesi de, köşk mescid kubbesi gibi mukarnaslı tromplar üzerine oturtulmuştur.  
  
Tasarım ve süslemeleriyle benzer özellikler gösteren Ağzıkara Han'ın iç ve dış taçkapıları geometrik motifli bezemelere sahiptir. Köşk mescid mihrabında da çeşitli gülbezek motiflerine yer verilmiştir.  
  
Anadolu Selçuklu kervansaraylarında avlu ve kapalı bölüm taçkapıları genelde aynı eksene konumlandırılmışken bu yapıda değişik bir uygulamaya gidilerek avlu taçkapısı yan cepheye yerleştirilmiştir. Yapı, avlusundaki köşk mescidiyle de Anadolu'daki nadir örneklerden biridir.

Avrupa'yı Asya'ya bağlayan Anadolu'da ticaretin ana eksenini oluşturan Konya-Kayseri yolu üzerindedir. Anadolu Selçuklu Dönemi avlulu kervansaraylarının önemli örneklerinden olan yapı, kapalı bölüm ile açık avludan oluşmaktadır. Köşe kuleleri ve payandalarla desteklenen yüksek kalın sağır duvarlarıyla bir kale gibi korunaklı inşa edilmiştir. Anadolu'da, açık avlusunda köşk mescid bulunan az sayıdaki han örneğinden birisidir.
dates: Kapalı kısım Şaban 628 / Haziran 1231; Avlu Şaban 637 / Şubat 1240.
keywords: ticaret; han; kervansaray; köşk-mescit; geometrik bezeme

en.name: Basilian Church of Santa Maria
description:
Together with the Churches of San Filippo di Fragalà, San Pietro at Itàla and Santi Pietro e Paolo in the Forza d’Agrò Valley, the Church of Santa Maria at Mili San Pietro provides the most interesting evidence of the presence of Basilian monks in the territories of Val Demone, handing down the memory of the role that their numerous monasteries (many of which were lost) covered during the period of the County in the process of the return of the island to Christianity.  
The church, which stands in the centre of a valley on the edge of the Mili stream is flanked by the houses of the monastery, which are all grouped so as to form short terraces, spread out at different levels. Access to the monumental complex is achieved by crossing a steep stairway, which starts on the provincial road. The church is already cited in a diploma written in Greek in 1092 by the Great Count Ruggero, who buried here his son Giordano, who died of fever at Syracuse, that same year. The church is built with a single nave with a tripartite santuario quite distinct from the *aula*, towards which three pointed arches are opened. The central bay of the *santuario*, ending with a semi-circular apse, is covered by a cupola on octagonal tambours connected by angular conical squinches made of multiple small arches with growing projections, interpreting in an original way former models of Aghlabite Islamic architecture. A cupola of very modest dimensions surmounts the two short lateral aisles of the *santuario*, which end in two niches made out of the thickness of the wall. The complex system of the santuario shows formal solutions analogous to those adopted by Muslim builders in the architectonic definition of the eastern part (*qibla*) of some Fatimid mosques of the 11th century.  
A wooden roof covers the *aula*; the body of the nave was prolonged by about a third of its length in the 16th century, with the consequent demolition of the original façade. The treatment of the external lateral and apsidal walls appear unusual, having numerous insertions of brickwork in the courses of calcareous stone. A relief of pointed arches, which, near the door are spread out with a single arcade *a rincasso*, enlivens the southern front. The upper area has a regular series of openings, alternating blind and light giving arches *a rincasso*. The treatment of the apsidal wall is of some interest, articulated by alternate pilasters and hanging arches according to a pattern widespread in the area of the so-called “Lombard-Romanesque”.

es.name: Iglesia basilia de Santa María
description: Junto con las de San Felipe de Fragalà, San Pedro de Itàla y Santos Pedro y Pablo del valle de Forza d’Agrò, la iglesia de Santa María de Mili constituye el testimonio más interesante de la presencia de los monjes basilios en los territorios de Val Demone, y trae a la memoria el papel que sus numerosos monasterios (muchos de los cuales se han perdido) desempeñaron en el periodo del Condado, durante el proceso de vuelta de la isla a la cristiandad. La iglesia se alza en el centro de un valle, al borde del torrente Mili, y está flanqueada por las construcciones del monasterio, agrupadas formando patios en terraza a distintos niveles. El acceso al conjunto monumental se hace por una empinada escalera que comienza en la carretera provincial. Citada ya en un diploma en griego de 1092 del gran conde Ruggero, que aquel mismo año habría hecho enterrar allí a su hijo Giordano, muerto de fiebres en Siracusa, la iglesia presenta una planta de nave única con presbiterio tripartito, bien diferenciado de la sala por tres arcos apuntados. La crujía central del presbiterio, terminada en un ábside semicircular, está cubierta por una cúpula semiesférica que se apoya sobre un tambor octogonal por medio de *trompas* angulares troncocónicas compuestas por arquitos múltiples progresivamente más salientes, una interpretación original de formas tomadas de la arquitectura árabe aglabí. Las dos pequeñas crujías laterales del presbiterio, que terminan en dos hornacinas practicadas en el espesor del muro, están coronadas por cúpulas de dimensiones muy modestas. El orden general del presbiterio revela soluciones formales análogas a las adoptadas por los constructores musulmanes en la arquitectura de la parte oriental (la *qibla*) de algunas mezquitas fatimíes del siglo XI. La sala está cubierta por un techo de madera, pero el cuerpo de la nave fue prolongado en cerca de una tercera parte en el siglo XVI, con la consiguiente demolición de la fachada original. Es singular el tratamiento de los paramentos murales exteriores de los lados y los ábsides, en los cuales están presentes numerosas intercalaciones de ladrillo en las hiladas de piedra calcárea. La fachada meridional está animada por un relieve de arcos apuntados entrecruzados que, en correspondencia con la puerta, de arco rehundido, se despliegan en una única arcada; la zona superior presenta una serie regular de vanos, con arcos rehundidos, alternativamente ciegos o con luz. De cierto interés resulta el tratamiento de la pared del ábside, articulada por *lesenas* y arcos pensiles, conforme a un motivo difundido en el área del llamado “románico lombardo”.

en.name: *Précis Historique de la Traite des Noirs et de l'Esclavage Colonial*
short_description: Joseph Elzéar Morénas (1776–1830) was born to a wealthy family of merchants. Following an early trip to India, Morénas became specialised in botany and developed a love of languages, which even led him to write a Hindi dictionary. When he was sent to Senegal in 1818 he was horrified by what he saw of the slave trade, and so asked to be repatriated. After a sojourn in Haiti, he began working on research in the agricultural sciences, all the while denouncing the "slave trade". His two petitions, "*Pétition contre la traite des noirs*" (1820 and 1821), which he presented to the Chamber of Deputies, created many problems for him. He therefore began working on a *Précis Historique de la Traite des Noirs et de l'Esclavage Colonial* instead, which was published in 1828. He died in Russia, where the Tsar encouraged the continuation of his agronomical work. This title page points to his relationship with and support for Cyril Bissette, a Martinician accused of having written De la Situation des Gens de Couleur Libres aux Antilles Françaises, who was banished by the royal court along with his so-called accomplices (Fabien and Volny).
keywords: Slavery; Africa; France

fr.name: *Précis historique de la traite des noirs et de l'esclavage colonial*
short_description: Joseph Elzéar Morénas (1776-1830), né dans une famille de commerçants aisés, retira d’un premier voyage aux Indes le goût des langues (il rédigea un dictionnaire d’hindoustani) et une spécialisation en botanique. Envoyé au Sénégal en 1818, il fut horrifié par l’exploitation « négrière » et demanda à être rapatrié. Après un séjour à Haïti, il s’employa à développer des recherches agronomiques tout en dénonçant la « traite des noirs ». Ses deux « Pétition contre la traite des noirs » (1820 et 1821) présentées à la Chambre des députés lui valurent de sérieux ennuis. Il s’attela alors à la rédaction d’un Précis historique de la traite des noirs et de l'esclavage colonial, publié en 1828. Il mourut en Russie où le tsar encourageait ses travaux agronomiques. La couverture de l’ouvrage montre son engagement et son soutien à Cyril Bissette, Martiniquais accusé d’avoir rédigé De la situation des gens de couleur libres aux Antilles Françaises et banni par la Cour royale avec ses soi-disant complices (Fabien et Volny).
keywords: Esclavage; Afrique; France

en.name: Model of the brig *Mariţa*
short_description: In 1834 Wallachia and Moldavia, which were under Ottoman suzerainty, were granted by the Ottoman Empire the right to sail on the Danube using their national banners. The first Romanian ship to sail under Romanian banner was the brig “Marița”, built in the naval dockyard of the Giurgiu port. Its owner was Wallachian politician Alexandru Vilara, who gave it the name of the wife of Alexandru II Ghica, Wallachia’s ruler between 1834-1842. “Marița” began its first trip in December 1834. Its destination was Istanbul, where it transported 300 kg of wheat. It returned in June 1835 after having been seriously damaged by two storms, one of which on its way back, when the crew had to throw overboard the wine purchased from Istanbul.

en.name: Monumental staircase
description: The monumental staircase has a complex structure, based on an elliptical plan. Two large flights of stairs embrace, rising, the area where the stair is placed; one more flight rises in the opposite direction driving to the first floor. From the balconies all around it is possible to observe the very suggestive and dynamic development of the stair, where reality and fiction are mixed up thanks to the illusive use of paintings by Ercole Graziani. Many years later Filippo Balugani realized the sculptures representing pagan gods that are placed over the balustrades.
artist: Giovanni Battista Torri; Carlo Fontana; Ercole Graziani; Filippo Balugani
partner: Musei Civici d’Arte Antica di Bologna in cooperation with the Province of Bologna

it.name: Scalone monumentale
description: Lo scalone monumentale ha una struttura complessa, basata su una pianta ellittica. Due ampie rampe abbracciano salendo il vano in cui è posta la scala; un'altra rampa sale nella direzione opposta, conducendo al primo piano. Dalle balconate attorno è possibile osservare lo sviluppo suggestivo e dinamico dello scalone, dove realtà e finzione si confondono grazie alla pittura illusionistica, opera di Ercole Graziani. Molti anni dopo  Filippo Balugani realizzò le statue che rappresentano divinità pagane, poste sulla balaustrata.
artist: Giovanni Battista Torri; Carlo Fontana; Ercole Graziani; Filippo Balugani

en.name: Bugatti Type 23
description: Bugatti built on its racing reputation in 1921 with the Type 13, which claimed the first four places in the Grand Prix des Voiturettes in Brescia, Italy. Since then this model has been known as the "Brescia", a name still sporadically used for the later 4-cylinder Types 22 and 23. This model is fitted with a Demaison & Cousin bodywork.
keywords: Lightweight; aluminium body; wire wheels; Grand Prix

ar.name: قطعة خشبية ملوّنة.
description:
ظهر في القصر B في منطقة الرقة مجموعة من الأساليب الزخرفية المنفذة بمواد متعددة منها الأطر الجصية التي تحيط بالأبواب والنوافذ والقطع الخشبية التي كانت تكسو جدران وأسقف القاعات الرسمية الملكية. وقد وُجِد ما يشبهها في العصر الأموي ويعود إلى قصر الحـير الغربي، وهذا دليل على استمرارية هذا النوع من الزخرفة حتى العصر العباسي.  
  
القطعة عبارة عن جزء مستطيل من لوح خشبي مدهون، يوجد في وسطها أشكال نباتية ووردية محوَّرة، وعلى جوانبها زخرفة هندسية. جميع هذه الرسومات منفذة بالألوان الأسود والأحمر والأصفر والبني بدرجات متفاوتة توحي بأن الرسومات ثلاثية الأبعاد.
لوحة خشبية، مرسوم عليها، كانت قد زيَّنت قاعة الانتظار بالقصر العباسي في الرقة، والتي تظهر الدقة العالية في الحفر الثلاثي الأبعاد، ذي الأشكال النباتية.
keywords: خشب؛ خشب مدهون؛ الرقة؛ قصر الحير الغربي؛ قصر B.

en.name: Fragment of a painted wooden panel.
description:
In Palace B in the Raqqa region, we find a group of applied ornamental techniques executed in various materials. These include the use of plaster frames for doors and windows as well as wooden panels to cover walls and ceilings of formal imperial halls. Similar forms and techniques existed in the Umayyad period and may be found in Qasr al-Hayr al-Gharbi. This indicates a continuation of this type of palatial decoration between the Umayyad and Abbasid periods.  
This rectangular fragment from a painted wooden panel is decorated with stylised floral and vegetal motifs bracketed by geometric designs. The decoration is executed in black, red, yellow and brown applied in gradual shades to make the drawings seem three-dimensional.
A painted wooden panel that once decorated the reception hall of an 'Abbasid palace in Raqqa reveals a high degree of expertise in three-dimensional shading of floral motifs.
keywords: Wood; Raqqa; Nasib Salibi

es.name: Fragmento de tablero pintado.
description:
En el Palacio B de la región de al-Raqqa se ha observado el uso de diversas técnicas ornamentales sobre diferentes materiales. Por ejemplo, se han encontrado molduras de escayola de puertas y ventanas, así como tableros de madera para revestir las paredes y los techos de los salones imperiales. En época omeya se usaban formas y técnicas similares, como puede apreciarse en Qasr al-Hayr al-Garbi. Esto pone de manifiesto una continuidad en la decoración palaciega entre los periodos omeya y abbasí.  
Este fragmento rectangular de un tablero pintado está decorado con estilizados motivos florales y vegetales, rodeados por diseños geométricos. La decoración está realizada en colores negro, rojo, amarillo y marrón, con distinta gradación para dar un aspecto tridimensional a los dibujos.

Este tablero de madera pintada, que en su momento estuvo en el salón de recepciones de un palacio abbasí de al-Raqqa, demuestra un gran dominio en la técnica del sombreado tridimensional de motivos florales.
keywords: Madera; al-Raqqa; Nasib Salibi.

fr.name: Fragment de panneau en bois peint.
description:
Les recherches sur le palais B de la région de Raqqa ont révélé un ensemble de techniques ornementales appliquées à divers matériaux dont des cadres en plâtre pour les portes et les fenêtres ou des lambris de bois pour recouvrir les murs et les plafonds des salles officielles. Ces formes et techniques similaires à celles des Omeyyades, comme, par exemple, à Qasr al-Khayr al-Gharbi, illustrent la continuité des décors palatiaux entre les périodes omeyyade et abbasside.  
Ce fragment rectangulaire faisait partie d'un panneau de bois peint de motifs floraux et végétaux stylisés encadrés de motifs géométriques. Le décor est peint en couleurs (noir, rouge, jaune et brun) de diverses nuances pour créer une impression de relief.
Ce panneau peint décorait jadis la salle de réception d'un palais abbasside à Raqqa. Il révèle un haut degré de talent dans la mise en forme tridimensionnelle des motifs floraux.
keywords: Bois ; Raqqa ; Nasib Salibi

en.name: Ten piasters
description: On obverse: "*amara bi ta'amul al-husayn bin 'ali 1338 'abduhu wa-ibn 'abdihi*" ("It is ordered to deal with by al-Hussein bin' Ali 1334, God servant"). On reverse: "*duriba bi-makka al-mukarrama sana 8 / al-hukuma al-'arabiyya al-hashimiyya / 'ashara / hashimi / qurush*" ("10 Piaster of Arab Hashemite Government, minted at Mecca al Mukarrama in reign year 8").
keywords: Hussein bin Ali; ten piasters; Arab Hashemite Government; Mecca al Mukarrama; coin; currency; coinage; numismatics

en.name: *Portrait of Ferdinand Laffert, Royal Commissioner*
description: The *Portrait of Baron Ferdinand Laffert* mixes official characteristics with a more personal style. The Baron was among the newcomers that gained estates after the Turks were ousted from Hungarian soil, and became the new landlord of a settlement in Ócsa, in Pest county near Buda, Hungary in 1693. He published one work during his lifetime, the *Publicus installationis actus in s. regni Hungariae coronae conservatorem excell., ac illustr. dni. comitis Georgii Leopoldi Erdődy de Monyorókerék ... Anno ab InItIo regnI HVungarIae, Ita & eXorDIo saCrae Coronae, Svpra septIngentos trIgesIMo. Posonii* in 1730.

An official portrait of Baron Ferdinand Laffert who was among the newcomers that gained estates after the Turks were ousted from Hungarian soil, and became the new landlord of a settlement in Ócsa, in Pest county near Buda, Hungary in 1693.
keywords: Portrait; book; Turks, Turkish Wars; Ottoman; Count Leopold Erdődy; Pozsony; Pressburg; Bratislava; Pest; Ócsa

ar.name: لهري (مخازن الحبوب).
description:
كانت القبائل العربية إبان عصر السلطان المولى إسماعيل، تدفع في الغالب ضرائبها عينياً، وبالتحديد من الحبوب. وقد احتلت الأَهْرِيةُ المعدة لتخزين محصول الضريبة مساحة منتقاة ضمن تصميم المدن الملكية، وكانت تشكل مستودعات للمنتجات الغذائية الضرورية لتموين المدن. واعتبرت السيطرة على هذه المخازن أولوية إستراتيجية للسلطة المتواجدة في الموقع، وخاصة خلال فترة النزاعات أو الجفاف.  
ولهذه الغاية، قام السلطان المولى إسماعيل ببناءهري كبير وواسع لخزن الحبوب، بجوار قصره. بُنيتْ جدرانه من طابية وردية اللون، وهي عبارة عن مزيج من التراب الصلصالي والجير والحصى وفي بعض الأحيان الحجر الدبش.  
شُيدتْ المعلمة على مساحة يبلغ طولها 182 متراً وعرضها 104 متراً، وتستند على 305 قوس و23 بلاطة، وجهتها جنوب - غرب وشمال - شرق، وتقدم بالتالي رسما منظوريا عميقاً ومتوازناً.  
كانت البناية التي تتألف من مجموعة من القاعات الضيقة نسبياً حول قاعة مركزية فسيحة ( طولها 26.30 متر وعرضها 10.70 متر وارتفاعها تحت السقف 9 أمتار)، تُستخدم لتخزين الحبوب الغذائية والعلف الضروري لـ 12000 من خيول الحرس الملكي. وظل الممشى المركزي طريقاً سالكاً حتى الجدار التالي، وقَسمتْ العضادات الحاملة لأقواس نصف دائرية، يبلغ قطرها 3 أمتار، القاعة إلى 18 أسكوب و23 بلاطة، كانت في البداية، مغطاة بقبوات أسطوانية؛ ويشكل هذا الجانب بالتحديد من المعلمة جزءا مدهشا. كما خصصت مساحة واسعة للبغال التي كانت تجلب الحبوب من شتى مناطق البلاد.  
وبفضل جدران جد سميكة، تمت المحافظة على درجة حرارة ثابتة لصيانة الغلال. وقد تحدث *مويت*، الذي بقي سجيناً في المغرب لمدة 11 سنة، وشارك في بناء القصبة الإسماعيلية، عن أسوار تصل سماكتها إلى 30 شبراً أي 7 أمتار.  
  
هدم لهري المخصص لتخزين الحبوب جزئياً اليوم، ويشرف على جزئه العلوي برج، كان يحتضن المدافع وآلات حربية أخرى كانت تستخدم لحماية القصر الملكي والمدينة.  
وقد تم إخلاء الصرح في القرن 12 الهجري / القرن 18 الميلادي، بعد زلزال لشبونة (سنة 1755) الذي أصاب مدينة مكناس، وهدم جزءاً من المعلمة. وتشكل هذه المخازنالمرممة حالياً زهرة التراث العلوي في مكناس.

تتألف هذه المطامير المبنية في القرن 17، تحت حكم السلطان المولى إسماعيل، فوق مساحة يصل طولها إلى 180 متر وعرضها إلى 104 متر، من بنايات مستطيلة واسعة كانت في الواقع عبارة عن مخازن تحت أرضية تهدمت قببها وسقوفها.  
تجاور هذه المطامير المحمولة بواسطة سلسلة تتكون من 22 صفاً من القناطر تضم كل واحدة منها 14 عقدا الجدرانَ الغربية لدار الناعورات، وتشرفُ على صهريج السواني.  
لقد كانت هذه المطامير، التي رممت في الآونة الأخيرة، مخصصة لتخزين المنتوجات الغذائية، وبشكل خاص القمح، توقعا للحصارات والحروب.
artist: السلطان المولى إسماعيل، (حكم في الفترة 1083 - 1140 هجري / 1672 - 1727 ميلادي).
keywords: هري؛ مخزن الغلال؛ أمن؛ تموين؛ تحصيل الضرائب.
partner: Ministry of Culture,Directorate of Cultural Heritage

en.name: Lahri (grain silo).
description:
During the reign of Sultan Mulay Isma'il, tribes often paid their taxes in kind, in particular with grain. The silos used to store the produce paid as taxes occupied a preferential position in the layout of royal towns and constituted an indispensable food reserve for supplying towns.  
Controlling these reserves was a strategic priority for the ruling body, especially during times of conflict and drought.  
For this purpose, Sultan Mulay Isma'il had a vast grain silo constructed, the Lahri, near to his palace. Its walls are built of pink adobe, a mix of clay earth, lime and stones, with occasional stone ashlars.  
The monument extends over an area measuring 182 m by 104 m. It rests on 305 arches and 23 south–east / north–west naves, giving an impression of depth and equilibrium.  
Composed of a series of relatively cramped rooms around a spacious central room (26.30 m by 10.70 m and 9 m to the ceiling), the building was used to store foodstuffs and the fodder needed for the 12,000 horses of the royal stud farm. A central avenue is still maintained all the way to the rear wall. The pillars supporting the semi-circular arches, 3 m in diameter, divide the room into 18 rows and 23 naves, originally covered with barrel vaults. This part of the monument is particularly impressive. A large space was reserved for the mules who brought the grain from different areas of the country.  
Its very thick walls maintained a constant temperature for the preservation of the foodstuffs. Moüette, who was a prisoner in Morocco for 11 years and who participated in the construction of Isma'il's *kasbah*, speaks of walls 30 spans, or 7 m, thick.  
The silo is now in partial ruin. A tower, which used to house cannons and other instruments of war to protect the royal palace and the *medina*, dominates the upper part.  
In the AH 12th / AD 18th century, the building was abandoned following the 1755 Lisbon earthquake, which affected the town of Meknès and destroyed part of this monument.  
Now restored, the silo is a highlight of the 'Alawid heritage of Meknès.

Built in the AH 11th / AD 17th century during the reign of Sultan Mulay Isma'il on a site measuring 182 m by 104 m, these vast rectangular structures were in fact underground granaries whose vaults and ceilings have collapsed. Supported on a series of 22 arcades of 14 arches each, these silos adjoin the west walls of the House of the Norias, and dominate the Sahrij Swani. These granaries were used to store foodstuffs, in particular wheat, as a contingency for sieges and wars. They have been recently restored.
keywords: Silo; granary; security
partner: Ministry of Culture, Directorate of Cultural Heritage

es.name: Lahri (silo).
description:
En la época del sultán Mulay Ismail, con frecuencia las tribus pagaban sus impuestos en especie, sobre todo en grano. Los silos para almacenar estos tributos ocupaban un lugar privilegiado en las ciudades reales, y los productos almacenados constituían unas reservas de alimentos indispensables para el aprovisionamiento de las ciudades. El control de dichas reservas, pues, era una prioridad estratégica para los gobernantes, especialmente en periodos de conflicto o sequía. Por ello, el sultán Mulay Ismail mandó construir un enorme silo de grano, el Lahri, próximo a su palacio.  
Los muros son de adobe rosa, una mezcla de tierra arcillosa, cal y grava, en ocasiones también guijarros. El monumento se alza sobre una superficie de 182 m de largo por 104 m de ancho. Descansa sobre 305 arcadas, que forman 23 naves orientadas en sentido sureste-noroeste, ofreciendo una perspectiva profunda y equilibrada.  
Consta de una serie de espacios relativamente pequeños que circundan un gran espacio central (26,30 x 10,70 m, 9 m de altura bajo techo). Se empleaba como depósito de alimentos y del forraje necesario para los 12.000 caballos de las cuadras reales.  
El paseo central puede aún recorrerse hasta el muro posterior. Los pilares que sostienen los arcos de medio punto, de tres metros de diámetro, dividen la sala en 18 tramos y 23 naves, originariamente cubiertas con bóvedas de cañón. Esta parte del monumento es realmente imponente. Un amplio espacio se reservaba a las mulas que traían el grano de las diversas regiones del país.  
Los espesos muros mantenían una temperatura constante para que los alimentos se conservaran. Un tal Müette, que estuvo cautivo en Marruecos durante 11 años y participó en la construcción de la *qasbah* ismailí, habla de unas murallas de 30 palmos de grosor, es decir, 7 m.  
Una torre domina la parte superior; en ella se conservan cañones y otros artefactos bélicos que servían para proteger el palacio real y la medina. En el siglo XII / XVIII, el edificio se abandonó a consecuencia del seísmo de Lisboa (1755), que afectó a la ciudad de Mequinez y destruyó una parte del monumento. Hoy se ha restaurado y está considerado una joya del patrimonio alauita de Meknes.

Este silo se construyó en tiempos del sultán Mulay Ismail en una superficie de 180 m por 104 m. Está formado por grandes edificios rectangulares que eran, en realidad, graneros subterráneos cuyas bóvedas y techos se desplomaron. Sostenido por una serie de 22 arcadas de 14 vanos cada una, linda con los muros oeste de la Casa de las Norias y domina el estanque de Sahriy Swani.  
Estos graneros se destinaban al almacenaje de alimentos, sobre todo trigo, en previsión de sitios y guerras. Se han restaurado recientemente.
dates: Siglos XI-XII de la Hégira / XVII-XVIII d. C.
keywords: Silo; granero; seguridad.
partner: Ministry of Culture,Directorate of Cultural Heritage

fr.name: Lahri (silo à grains).
description:
à l'époque du sultan Moulay Ismaïl, les tribus payaient souvent leurs impôts en nature, notamment en grain. Les silos destinés au stockage du produit de l'impôt occupaient une place de choix dans le plan des villes royales et constituaient des réserves de produits alimentaires indispensables pour ravitailler les villes.  
Contrôler ces réserves était une priorité stratégique pour le pouvoir en place, surtout en période de conflits ou de sécheresse.  
à cette fin, le sultan Moulay Ismaïl avait fait construire un grand et vaste silo à grains, le Lahri, à proximité de son palais. Ses murs sont construits en pisé rose, un mélange de terre argileuse, de chaux et de cailloux, avec parfois des moellons de pierre.  
Le monument s'élève sur une surface de 182 m de long et 104 m de large. Il repose sur 305 arcades et 23 nefs orientées dans le sens sud-est/nord-ouest, offrant ainsi une perspective profonde et équilibrée.  
Composé d'une série de salles relativement exiguës autour d'une salle centrale spacieuse (26,30 x 10,70 m, 9 m de hauteur sous plafond), le bâtiment servait à entreposer les denrées alimentaires et le fourrage nécessaire aux 12 000 chevaux du haras royal. Une allée centrale est maintenue praticable jusqu'au mur postérieur. Des piliers soutenant des arcs en plein cintre de 3 mètres de diamètre divisent la salle en 18 travées et 23 nefs, initialement couvertes de voûtes en berceau. Cette partie du monument est particulièrement impressionnante. Un large espace était réservé aux mulets qui ramenaient les grains des différentes régions du pays.  
Grâce à des murs très épais, une température constante était maintenue pour la conservation des denrées ; le sieur Moüette, qui est resté prisonnier au Maroc pendant onze ans et qui a participé à la construction de la casbah ismaïlienne, parle de murailles d'une épaisseur de 30 empans, soit 7 m.  
Le silo est aujourd'hui partiellement en ruine. Une tour domine sa partie supérieure. Elle abritait les canons et autres machines de guerre qui servaient à protéger le Palais royal et la médina.  
Au XIIe siècle H (XVIIIe siècle J.-C.), l'édifice a été abandonné après le séisme de Lisbonne (1755) qui a touché la ville de Meknès et détruit une partie du monument.  
Aujourd'hui restauré, le silo constitue un fleuron du patrimoine alaouite de Meknès.

Construits au XVIIe siècle sous le règne du sultan Moulay Ismaïl sur un espace de 180 m de long et 104 m de large, ces silos sont constitués de vastes bâtiments rectangulaires qui étaient en fait des greniers souterrains dont les voûtes et plafonds se sont effondrés.  
Soutenus par une série de 22 arcades de 14 arcs chacune, ces silos jouxtent les murs ouest de la Maison aux Norias, et dominent le Sahrij Swani.  
Ces greniers étaient destinés à entreposer les produits alimentaires, notamment le blé, en prévision des sièges et des guerres. Ils ont été récemment restaurés.
dates: XIe-XIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XVIIe- XVIIIe siècle J.-C.).
artist: Le sultan Moulay Ismaïl (1083-1140 H / 1672-1727 J.-C.).
keywords: silo ; grenier ; sécurité
partner: Ministry of Culture,Directorate of Cultural Heritage

de.name: Stuck
description: Der von einem Hauptmeister der Wessobrunner Stuckatorenschule ausgeführte Stuck verbindet Motive der frühbarocken Münchner Stucktradition, insbesondere geometrische Felderungen, Lorbeerbündel und Engelshermen, mit Wessobrunner Motiven wie eingerollten Schneckenformen und Muscheln. Die Einzelmotive sind zumeist mit hölzernen Modelformen gegossen.
artist: Entwurf: Konstantin Pader; Ausführung: Matthias II. Schmuzer

en.name: Stucco
description: The stuccowork was crafted by one of the great masters of the stucco school  in Wessobrunn, where the central themes were snail and shell ornaments. He combined those with traditional motifs from the Early Baroque stucco art in Munich, particularly laurel branches, herms of angels, and strips of stuccowork framing geometrically configured sections. The single motifs are mostly cast with wooden moulds.
artist: Design: Konstantin Pader; Execution: Matthias II Schmuzer
partner: University of Munich, Institute of Art History

en.name: Royal Palace
description:
The Royal Palace in Coimbra dates back to the time of the first King of Portugal, D. Afonso Henriques, who lived and possibly died here. There was, however, a fort on this site many centuries earlier and some of its remains were incorporated into the Manueline buildings. The round towers on the exterior wall facing the old cathedral, the Sé Velha, date from this period, as do the large windows, visible in the Via Latina and belonging to what used to be the Throne Room, now the Ceremonial Hall, as well as a number of interesting doorways and arches on the ground floor in the area now occupied by the Instituto Jurídico.  
The most interesting building is the Chapel of São Miguel with its Manueline portal and *triumphal arch* with rope carving. This was the work of Marcos Pires, Boytac’s leading disciple, who worked there from 1517 to 1521.

en.name: Archaeological excavations
short_description: General view of the pyramids of Abusir, in the area of the pyramids of the king Userkaf and king Neferirkare. These pyramids represent vestiges of the Fifth Dynasty, and they date back to 2800 BC (Old Kingdom). The paper photograph is printed from glass plate negatives.

en.name: The Old Woman from Candia [Heraklion, Crete, Greece], the Only Person who Remained in Apollonia on the Day of the Occupation
names: An old Greek woman who was the only person remaining in the Libyan town Marsa Susa when the Italian army occupied it
short_description:
This picture was taken by an Italian military unit during the Italian invasion of Libya.  
Apollonia was the name of an ancient town, dating back to the 7th century BC. By 1911, Apollonia was nothing more than an archaeological site. The modern Arab town was called Marsa Susa. The Italians’ use of the ancient name was intended to remind readers that Libya was once under Roman rule. Italian colonialists claimed that Italy had an historic right to rule over Libya, since the Roman Empire once ruled over that country.
holder: Italian Institute for African and Oriental Studies

de.name: Apostelstatue
description: Der aus 14 Apostelstatuen bestehende Zyklus ist im Kirchenraum umlaufend vor wandnischenartigen Rahmungen aufgestellt. Die bemerkenswerten Arbeiten stammen aus der Werkstatt des Bildhauers Johann Paterer aus Lienz.

en.name: Apostle statues
description: The cycle of 14 apostle statues is arranged around the perimeter of the church interior, framed by alcove-like recesses. These remarkable works originate from the workshop of the sculptor Johann Paterer of Lienz.

de.name: Stiftskirche, der Himmelfahrt Mariens und dem hl Jacobus dem Älteren geweiht
description:
Die Abtei-Kirche wurde von Abt Benedikt Rieger erbaut. Ebenfalls unter ihm erhielten die Decke und die Wände die reiche, plastische Ausgestaltung. Es gibt zahllose Stuck-Girlanden aus Blättern, Blumen und Früchten, Deckengemälde mit 3D-Stuckrahmen und zig Statuen von Putti (= männliche Kleinkinder), Engeln und Heiligen. Kein Stück Wand blieb frei. Nivard II Dierer folgte als Abt und beschied sich damit, das Interieur weiter zu verschönern. Er, der einer wohlhabenden Familie entstammte und der Schloss Versailles gesehen hatte, dekorierte enthusiastisch die Kirche in einem zweiten barocken Durchgang. Er ließ die Pilaster mit einer „zweiten Schichte“ von vergoldetem Schnitzwerk und gerahmten Blumenstillleben überziehen, und es war wahrscheinlich er, der den ursprünglich weiß gekalkten(?) Stuck farbig übermalen und (später) vergolden ließ. Das fand man vor kurzem bei Entnahmen für bevorstehende Restaurierungsarbeiten heraus: in Abt Nivards II Ära waren der Stuck und der Hintergrund der Decke zartrosa, die Skulpturen – Putti und Heilige – dunkelrosa und die Pilaster blaugrau marmoriert. Vermutlich nur ein wenig später war der Stuck an den Wänden und in den Seitenkapellen vergoldet (der Abt mag sich an Versailles erinnert haben). Die vergoldeten und versilberten Stuckteile im Bernhardisaal (s. dort) vermitteln eine Idee, wie der Stuck in der Kirche ausgesehen haben mag, als er vergoldet war.  
Das Hochaltargemälde zeigt die Himmelfahrt Mariens – die Muttergottes sitzt auf einer Wolke und bewegt sich in Richtung Paradies. Sie ist von Engeln umgeben, die Rosen in ihr Grab streuen.
place: Sie befindet sich beinahe in der Mitte einer Vierflügelanlage, zwischen dem Prälatenhof und dem Konventhof.
artist: Giovanni Battista Carlone (Stuckfiguren, Freskos – lt. eines erhaltenen Vertrags) und Bartolomeo Carlone (Stuckpflanzen und -Ornamente); Franz Werner Tamm (Hochaltargemälde); Johann Michael Rottmayr und Johann Karl von Reslfeld (Seitenaltar-Gemälde); Johann Josef Wanscher (Schnitzarbeiten, Stuck); Johann Christoph Jobst? (Statuen Hochaltar)

en.name: Stiftskirche/Abbey Church, dedicated to the Ascension of Maria and to Saint Jacob/James the Elder
description:
The abbey church was built under abbot Benedikt Rieger. It was also under him that the ceiling and the walls got the rich and artistic sculptural design. There are myriads of stucco garlands made of leaves, flowers and fruits as well as ceiling paintings framed with 3D stucco and umpteen statues of putti (male toddlers), angels and saints. No square centimetre was left empty. Nivard II Dierer succeeded as abbot and contented himself with embellishing the interior. He – who had come from a wealthy family and who had seen Versailles Palace – was enthusiastically re-decorating the church. He added a “second layer” of gilded carvings and framed flower still lifes to the pilasters and it was probably he who had coloured and (later) gilded the originally white limed(?) stucco. This was found out recently in thorough analysis with regard to forthcoming restoration works: in Abbot Nivard´s II era all the stucco work on the ceiling as well as the background was light pink, the sculptures – putti and saints – dark pink and the pilasters were marbled grey blue. Probably a bit later, all the stucco of the walls and side chapels was gilded (the abbot may have remembered Versailles Palace). The gold and silver surfaces in the Bernhardisaal (s. Detail 2) give an impression of how the church may have looked when the stucco was gilded.  
The high altar painting is dedicated to the Assumption – the Mother of God, sitting on a cloud, is ascending to heaven. She is surrounded by angels who sprinkle roses into her grave.
place: Almost in the middle of the abbey’s four-wing complex, between the prelate’s court and the cloister.
artist: Stucco figures and fresco paintings: Giovanni Battista Carlone (according to a preserved contract); stucco plants and ornaments: Bartolomeo Carlone; high altar painting: Franz Werner Tamm; side altar paintings: Johann Michael Rottmayr and Johann Karl von Reslfeld; carvings, stucco: Johann Josef Wanscher; statues, high altar: Johann Christoph Jobst?

en.name: Two pistols
short_description: These Turkish flintlock pistols were used by the Ottoman soldiers in Lebanon in the 19th century to quash resistance movements. As the Lebanese resistance had no weapons of their own, the fighters frequently ambushed Ottoman soldiers and took their weapons. These pistols are an example of such weaponry, which was taken by the resistance and used against the Ottomans. They were commonly known as "knee pistols", as they were fired from horseback by placing the butt of the pistol against the rider's knee. Both have a typical blunderbuss style stock with a beautifully shaped butt stock, a wooden forend and a round barrel. They are made of wood and cast steel.
type: Military object; metalwork; firearms; arms and armour
keywords: Military object; Metalwork; Steel; Arms; armour; Pistol

ar.name: مطرة للحج.
description: القطعة عبارة عن مطرة فخارية يطلق عليها أيضاً اسم زمزمية لأنها كانت تملأ من قبل الحجاج بمياه زمزم في مكة المكرمة. هذا النوع من المطرات لونه قشدي (كريمي). تصنع هذه المطرات من جزأين كل منهما له قالب، ويتم بعد ذلك وصلهما معاً، ومن ثم يضاف العنق والمقبضان. وزوّدت هذه المطرة بزخرفة على شكل ضفيرة لإخفاء مكان اتصال جزئين معاً. تظهر على مثل هذه المطرات المصنوعة بالقالب زخارف ناتئة تمثل شعارات أو رنوك كبار الموظفين المرتبطين عادة بالبلاط الرسمي الأيوبي أو المملوكي. تبدو على هذه المطرة زهرة زنبق محاطة من كل جانب بسيف، وهي تمثل شعار العديد من السلاطين والأمراء في ذلك الوقت.

مَطَرة أو زمزمية حاج خزفية، أخذت اسمها الثاني من بئر زمزم المُقدَّس في مكة. إنها مصنوعة من قرصين مقولبين موصولين، في التصميم زنبقة في الوسط، مع سيف في كل جانب، وهو شعار عائد إلى عدد من سلاطين العصر وأمرائه.
place: ربما تكون قد صنعت في سورية.
keywords: خزف؛ زخرفة رمزية؛ زخرفة ناتئة؛ زخرفة نافرة؛ فخار.

en.name: A pilgrim’s flask.
description:
A ceramic pilgrim's flask, sometimes called a Zamzameyyah, due to the fact that pilgrims used to fill such flasks with holy water from the famous well in Mecca called Zamzam.  
  
This type of ware is usually tan or creamy buff in color. These flasks are made of two separate moulded discs which are joined together; the neck and handles are then added. There is a guilloche decoration at the juncture to hide the join. The moulds of the discs have hollow decorations to form a pattern in relief on the surface of the flasks. Often the decoration includes an emblem or rank to indicate the status or profession of the owner, normally an official associated with the Ayyubid or Mamluk court. On this particular flask we have a lily in the middle with a sword on either side, an emblem belonging to several sultans and amirs of the time.

A ceramic pilgrim’s flask or zamzamiyyah after the holy well of Zamzam in Mecca. Made of two moulded discs which are joined together, the design has a lily in the middle with a sword on either side, an emblem belonging to several sultans and amirs of the time.
keywords: Relief decoration; pilgrimage

es.name: Cantimplora de peregrino
description:
Las cantimploras de peregrino solían utilizarse para guardar el agua sagrada procedente del famoso pozo de Zamzam, en la Meca, por lo que en ocasiones se denominan *zamzamiyya*.  
Este tipo de cerámica suele tener un tono tostado o crema. Las cantimploras se fabricaban a partir de dos discos que se modelaban unidos; el cuello y las asas se agregaban después. Una decoración trenzada oculta la juntura. Las molduras de los discos están adornadas con surcos que forman un motivo en relieve sobre la superficie. A menudo esta decoración contenía un emblema o un rango que indicaba el estatus o la profesión de su dueño, normalmente un funcionario de la corte ayyubí o la mameluca. Esta cantimplora en concreto presenta un lirio entre dos espadas, emblema de varios sultanes y emires de la época.

Cantimplora de peregrino o *zamzamiyya* para el agua sagrada de Zamzam (La Meca). Está formada por dos discos modelados unidos y adornada con un lirio entre dos espadas, emblema de varios sultanes y emires de la época.
dates: Siglo VIII de la Hégira / XIV d. C.
keywords: Decoración en relieve

fr.name: Gourde de pèlerin.
description:
Gourde de pèlerin en céramique, parfois appelée *zamzameyyah* par référence à Zamzam, le célèbre puits de La Mecque où les pèlerins remplissaient leur bouteille d'eau consacrée.  
Ces gourdes, généralement de couleur jaune ou beurre frais, sont faites de deux parties circulaires moulées et assemblées avant l'ajout du col et des poignées. Un décor guilloché masque le joint entre les deux parties. Les décors en creux des moules imprimaient divers motifs à la surface de la bouteille. Souvent, le décor comprenait un emblème qui indiquait le statut ou la profession de son propriétaire, habituellement un personnage officiel proche de la cour ayyoubide ou mamelouke. Sur cette bouteille figure au centre un lys entre deux épées, emblème de plusieurs sultans et émirs de l'époque.

Gourde de pèlerin en céramique ou *zamzameyyah* par référence à Zamzam, le puits saint de La Mecque. La gourde est faite de deux parties circulaires moulées assemblées entre elles ; le dessin figure au centre un lys entre deux épées, un emblème appartenant à plusieurs sultans et émirs de l’époque.
dates: VIIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIVe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: Décoration en bas-relief

en.name: Lausanne with its cathedral in the background
description: The views of towns and tourist attractions by British photographer Francis Frith were extremely sought-after in the second half of the 19th century. He sold large numbers of his photographs, such as this view of the town of Lausanne, and ran a company working internationally. On the one hand, his success was based on the need of the developing tourism sector for images and souvenirs. On the other hand, Frith saw things in ways familiar from graphic images and painting.
keywords: Lausanne; Albumen Print; Francis Firth; Tourism;

en.name: Ford Model T Touring
description:
This weathered wagon personifies one of the most influential cars of the 20th century – the Ford T-Model. Production numbers peaked in the 1920s as demand rose from around the globe due to their affordable price and high-quality materials.  
  
The American owner of this Touring-model would spend most of his days keeping to himself out in the forest. In addition to the soft-top and storm curtains that provided ample protection in any weather and terrain, the farmer equipped the car with a net to entrap rabbits and snakes and drums for transporting milk.  
  
In 1924, more than half of all cars sold worldwide were T-models, making this car a recognisable collectible whilst also encapsulating the adventures of different people such as this huntsman.
holder: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani
keywords: Classic Cars; Touring; Four-Door; Hunting Vehicles; Ford; Model T
materials: Steel, aluminium, glass, leather, wood, rubber, paint, plastic; assembling, moulding, welding, painting
tags: Steel, aluminium, glass, leather, wood, rubber, paint, plastic
partner: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani Museum (FBQ Museums)

en.name: *Sybil*
description:
The work was obtained by Cardinal Scipione Borghese in 1617, and may originally have been commissioned from Domenichino by Cardinal Pietro Aldobrandini, although this is not certain. It is the first known piece having this subject (there is another original from 1622 in Rome at the Pinacoteca Capitolina).  
It shows one of the famous 'ideal figures' created by the painter through a progressive selection of forms until a studied, classical equilibrium between nature and perfection, beauty and expression of emotion is achieved: the representation of moods that is a central theme in the language of the Baroque.  
The figure assumes a singing pose. Numerous details refer to the musical background of the artist, who was a frequent visitor to the *Kapellmeisters* of Bologna. In this context Domenichino started to research a musical form that was entirely new at the time and that would become the style of instrumental Baroque music par excellence: the *trio sonata*. The maiden sits beside a beautifully carved viol and is holding a musical score in her hands. The laurel bushes allude allegorically to Apollo, to whom the sibyls were devoted, while the vine refers to the god, Bacchus, who is associated with poetic inspiration.  
The 11 pagan sibyls communicate the responses of the god Apollo through the oracles. Christian doctrine interpreted these maidens, who were dedicated to divinity, as forerunners of Christianity, attributing them the role of prophets of the coming of Christ. The female figure with her head bound in a turban alludes to the martyr Cecilia, whose body was miraculously found intact at the beginning of the 17th century, and whose story was painted as a fresco by Domenichino in the church of San Luigi dei Francesi. The painting shows an extraordinary synthesis between the colours of Bolognese painting and the drawing of Raphael and Leonardo's theories on aerial perspective, established at around the same time.

The Sybil, holding a musical score in her hand, is portrayed as the revelator of the Divine Word. The figure is connected to the discovery of the body of Saint Cecilia, patron saint of music, in Trastevere, from whom it borrows the image of the turban as worn by the martyr, who was found near to the basilica of the same name in Trastevere.  
Through a selection of forms the painter reaches a refined and classical balance between nature and perfection; between beauty and the expression of feelings.
artist: Domenico Zampieri, also known as Domenichino
keywords: Classical model; ancient art; music; musical instrument; symbol; turban; exoticism; ideal figure; mythology; Christian themes; cult of martyrdom

it.name: *Sibilla*
description: L'opera entrò in possesso del cardinale Scipione Borghese nel 1617, ma non è accertato se il dipinto sia stato originariamente commissionato a Domenichino dal cardinale Pietro Aldobrandini. E' la prima tra le versioni conosciute raffiguranti questo soggetto (ne esiste un'altra autografa del 1622 a Roma, presso la Pinacoteca Capitolina). Vi è rappresentata una delle celebri “figure ideali”, create dal pittore attraverso una progressiva selezione delle forme condotta fino al raggiungimento di un ricercato e classico equilibrio tra naturalezza e perfezione, tra bellezza ed espressione degli “affetti”: quella raffigurazione dei moti dell'animo, cioè, che fu uno dei temi centrali del linguaggio barocco. La figura è atteggiata nella posa del canto; numerosi dettagli rimandano alle conoscenze musicali dell'artista, assiduo frequentatore dei “maestri di cappella” a Bologna. In questo ambito Domenichino era impegnato infatti nelle ricerche di una forma musicale del tutto innovativa per l'epoca e che sarebbe diventata il genere di musica strumentale barocco per eccellenza: la “sonata a tre”. La fanciulla siede accanto a una viola da gamba riccamente intagliata, tenendo tra le mani uno spartito musicale. Le piante di alloro alludono allegoricamente ad Apollo, cui le sibille erano consacrate, mentre la pianta di vite richiama il dio Bacco, a cui si associava l'ispirazione poetica. Le undici sibille pagane comunicavano i responsi del dio Apollo attraverso gli oracoli. La dottrina cristiana interpretò queste fanciulle consacrate alla divinità come figure anticipatrici del Cristianesimo, attribuendo loro la funzione di profetesse della venuta di Cristo. La tipologia femminile con il capo circondato dal turbante richiama quella della martire Cecilia, il cui corpo fu ritrovato miracolosamente intatto all'inizio del XVII secolo e la cui storia lo stesso Domenichino affrescò nella chiesa di San Luigi dei Francesi. Il dipinto rappresenta una straordinaria sintesi tra il colore della pittura bolognese, il disegno di Raffaello e le teorie di Leonardo sulla prospettiva aerea, riprese proprio in quegli anni.

La Sibilla, che tiene in mano lo spartito musicale, è ritratta come la rivelatrice delle Parola Divina. La figura è collegata alla scoperta del corpo di Santa Cecilia, protettrice delle musica, di cui riprende il tema del turbante, indossato dalla martire ritrovata nei pressi dell'omonima basilica in Trastevere.  
Attraverso una selezione di forme il pittore ha raggiunto un raffinato e classico equilibrio tra naturale e perfezione, tra bellezza e espressione dei sentimenti.  
Il Cardinale Scipione Borghese si proclamò protettore della pittura e della musica.
keywords: Modello classico; arte antica; musica;  strumento musicale; simbolo; turbante; esoticismo; figura ideale; mitologia; tematiche cristiane; culto del martirio

en.name: Carpet
description:
In 1664 Jean-Baptiste Colbert, King Louis XIV’s minister in charge of buildings, began a campaign to transform the Louvre (the royal residence at the time) into the grandest and largest palace in Europe. Central to this project was the renovation of a 1,450-foot-long space known as the Grande Galerie. This amazing interior overlooked the Seine and connected the Louvre and Tuileries palaces.  
For this hall Colbert commissioned the Savonnerie carpet factory to produce ninety-three carpets. The commission’s scale was unprecedented in the history of French woven arts, and the carpets that were ultimately produced rank among the greatest artistic achievements of the 1600s.  
Production of the carpets, which were each some thirty feet in length and required the construction of new looms made from particularly long and stout tree trunks, began in 1668 and continued until 1688, by which time the king had lost interest in the project and moved the court to Versailles. In the following centuries the carpets were given away as diplomatic gifts or, on special occasions, brought out of storage for use at the royal residences and elsewhere.  
In 1788 the Museum’s carpet was sent for one day to the Paris church of Saint-Roch for the marriage of the Duke de Montmorency. And on June 18, 1919, when the treaty that ended World War I was signed at Versailles, twenty-four of the carpets adorned the Galerie des Glaces (Hall of Mirrors).  
Although each of the Savonnerie carpets is individual in design, they share certain distinct traits: a black background, a modified egg-and-leaf border, scrolling acanthus leaves in the corners, and cartouches at each end that contain either a landscape or allegorical scene. All display decorations replete with royal emblems. The design of the Museum’s carpet includes the crowned monogram of the king four times in the center and a crowned globe with the motto NEC PLURIBUS IMPAR (One Among Many) at each end.
artist: Manufacturer: Made by the Savonnerie carpet manufactory, Paris, 1627 - 1825;Modeler: After a model made by Charles Le Brun, French (active Paris), 1619 - 1690; Modeler: or Louis Le Vau, French, 1612 - 1670
keywords: Carpet; Rug

de.name: *Padishah* kilim
description: Die hauchfeine Seidenwirkerei mit Metallfäden erhielt ihren Namen aufgrund des in vier Kartuschen eingewebten Wortes Padischah. Es handelt sich um die persische Bezeichnung für Kaiser oder Fürst. Der Aufbau der Wirkerei entspricht dem eines Medaillon-Teppichs. Im Zentrum des Innenfeldes befindet sich ein grüngrundiges Medaillon mit einem Kampf zwischen Drache und Phönix. Die Zwickel zeigen rotgrundige Viertelmedaillons gefüllt mit dem Fabelwesen Khilin. Diese Motive entstammen dem ostasiatischen Kulturkreis und sind in der islamischen Kunst spätestens seit dem 13. Jahrhundert bekannt. Das Innenfeld ist zudem mit zahlreichen Blüten und Vögeln gefüllt. Die Bordüre besetzen abwechselnd längliche Kartuschen und Vierpassmedaillons. Gefüllt sind die Kartuschen mit Raubtieren, die Medaillons mit grotesken Gesichtern. Technisch besteht diese Wirkerei, anders als ein Knüpfteppich, nur aus Kett- und Schussfäden. Es sind keine florbildenden Knoten eingeknüpft. Die Besonderheit des Stückes liegt in seiner Materialität. Die heute grau erscheinenden Bereiche im Feld und der Bordüre waren ursprünglich silbrig glänzend. Auch die gelben und roten Flächen waren mit Metallfäden verziert. Die feinen Metallstreifen, die um eine Seidenseele gesponnen wurden, sind mittlerweile korrodiert, wodurch eine Reflexion des Lichts und der umgebenden Farbflächen nicht mehr zur Wirkung kommt. Auch muss man sich die Farbigkeit der Wirkerei sehr kräftig und leuchtend vorstellen. Da Seide sehr empfindlich ist, sind die Farben aufgrund von Lichteinwirkung besonders auf der Vorderseite stark verblasst. Der unscharfe Eindruck der Motive liegt in der Technik begründet. Verschieden farbige Schüsse werden verzahnt, also abwechselnd um eine gemeinsame Kette geführt. Dadurch entsteht eine unscharfe Konturlinie und Schlitze vermieden, die die Stabilität des Textils beeinträchtigen würden.
holder: Museum für Islamische Kunst, Pergamon Museum

en.name: *Padishah* kilim
description: This extremely fine silk tapestry weaving with metal thread was given its name on account of the word *Padishah* woven into four cartouches. This is the Persian word for emperor or prince. The overall design corresponds to that of a medallion carpet. In the centre of the inner field is a green-ground medallion with a battle between a dragon and a phoenix. The spandrels contain red-ground quarter-medallions filled with the mythical creatures called *qilin*. These motifs derive from East Asian cultures and have been known in Islamic art at least since the 13th century. In addition the inner field is filled with a number of blossoms and birds. In the borders are elongated cartouches alternating with quatrefoil medallions. The cartouches are filled with beasts of prey, the medallions with grotesque faces. Technically this tapestry weaving, unlike a knotted carpet, consists only of warp and weft threads. There are no knots forming a pile. The special character of the piece lies in its materials. The areas in the field and border which today appear grey were originally gleaming silver. The yellow and red surfaces were also adorned with metal threads. These fine metal threads, which were spun around a silk core filament, have by now become corroded, so that they no longer effectively reflect the light and the surrounding colour surfaces. One must also imagine the tapestry as highly and vividly colourful. Since silk is very delicate, the colours, particularly on the front, have become seriously faded on account of their exposure to light. The blurred impression given by the motifs is accounted for by the technique. Various coloured wefts have been interlocked, that is, alternately wound around a common warp. This produces a soft outline, but avoids the appearance of slits, which would have detracted from the stability of the textile.
holder: Museum of Islamic Art at the Pergamon Museum
keywords: Silk; Kelim; Padischah; Inscription; Dragon; Phoenix; Princess Victoria
partner: Museum of Islamic Art at the Pergamon Museum, State Museums

ar.name: صندوق أقلام
description:
ا يُعرف سوى القليل عن الرسام محمد يوسف. كما يشهد توقيعه ، فهو ابن محمد زمان (نشط هجري حوالي 1072-1105 هجري/ميلادي حوالي 1662-1694). إلى جانب علبة الأقلام المعروضة هنا ، لم يُعرف سوى اثنتين أخريين ، وكلاهما موجود في متحف الفنون الزخرفية في طهران. مثل أخيه المعروف محمد علي ، تخصص محمد يوسف على ما يبدو في الرسم بالورنيش. كما يوجد له عمل رابع يعدجزء مما يسمى ألبوم بلوفتسوفا الموجود في سانت بطرسبرغ. يعود تاريخه إلى 1108 هـجري (1696/97 ميلادي) وهو أقدم عمل معروف ومنشور لمحمد يوسف حتى الآن. تظهر على السطح العلوي لعلبة الأقلام امرأة شابة رسمت من الأمام ترتدي ملابس فاخرة في منظر طبيعي. وجودالعديد من الزخارف الأوروبية ، يعد نموذجيأً للمناظر الطبيعية لمحمد زمان وأخيه الحاج محمد (نشط هجري 1084-1124 / ميلادي 1673-1712). من ناحية أخرى ، يعود رسم الشابة إلى نوع امن التصوير الذي كان شائعًا في بلاد فارس الصفوية من حوالي 1660 إلى أواخر الثمانينيات من القرن السابع عشر.  
تم "اختراعه"من قبل بهرام سفره‌کش (نشط 1030-1050 هجري/ ميلادي 1621-1640) على الأرجح في ديكان بجنوب الهند ، ثم تم جلبه إلى أصفهان حوالي عام 1640 ، حيث طوره الشيخ عباسي (نشط هجريًا 1057-1094 / ميلادياً1647-1683 ) ثم اقتبسها رسامون آخرون. زُينت جوانب المقلمة بمجموعة من الزهور المختلفة. تم العثور على هذه "اللوحات التصويرية المزهرة" لأول مرة في عمل شافعي عباسي (نشط 1040-1066 هجري / 1631-1656ميلادي) ، وتم دمجها لاحقًا في أعمال محمد زمان وخاصة في اعمال شقيقه.

en.name: Pencase
description:
Little is known of the painter Muhammad Yusuf. As his signature attests, he was the son of Muhammad Zaman (active Hegira ca. 1072-1105 / AD ca. 1662-1694). Besides the pencase presented here, only two others are known, both of which are in the Museum of Decorative Arts in Tehran. Like his better-known brother Muhammad ʿAli, he apparently specialised in lacquer paintings. A fourth work is part of the so-called Plovtsova Album in St. Petersburg (VP-7153); it is dated Hegira 1108 (AD 1696/97) and so far the oldest known and published work by Muhammad Yusuf.  
  
The pencase shows a sumptuously dressed young woman in a landscape on the front. With its many Europeanising motifs, it is typical of the landscapes of Muhammad Zaman and his brother Haji Muhammad (active Hegira 1084-1124 / AD 1673-1712). The young woman, on the other hand, goes back to a figure type that was popular in Safavid Persia from around 1660 to the late 1680s. "Invented" by Bahram Sofrakish (active Hegira 1030-1050s / AD 1621-1640s) probably in the Deccan in South India, he brought it to Isfahan around 1640, where it was further developed by Shaykh ʿAbbasi (active Hegira 1057-1094 / AD 1647-1683) and then taken up by other painters. The sides of the pencase are decorated with an array of different flowers. Such "flower portraits" are first found in the work of Shafiʿ Abbasi (active Hegira 1040-1066 / AD 1631-1656), and are later incorporated into the work of Muhammad Zaman and especially his brother.

de.name: Maurisches Schild (*Adarga*)
description: Der Schildtypus der Ardaga geht auf nordafrikanisch-maurische Vorbilder zurück. Von dieser nierenförmigen Schildform leitet auch der abendländische Ovalschild, die Tartsche, seinen Namen her. Die prunkvolle Ausführung der vorliegenden Ardaga mit bunter Seidenstickerei deutet auf einen hochgestellten Besitzer hin. Der Wiener Schild dürfte über die Heirat Philipps I., des Schönen (1478-1506), mit Juana I. von Kastilien (1479-1555) in den Besitz der Habsburger gelangt sein. Im späten 16. Jahrhundert war die Ardaga Teil der Sammlung Erzherzog Ferdinands II. (1529-1595) auf Schloss Ambras bei Innsbruck.

en.name: Moorish shield (*adarga*)
description: The shape of this shield is derived from North African and Moorish models. The name of this kidney-shaped shield also informed the name of an oval shield popular in the Occident, the *Tartsche*. The *adarga* is covered with colourful silk embroidery, suggesting a high-ranking owner. The shield, now in Vienna, probably entered the Habsburg collections when Juana I of Castile (AD 1479–1555) married Philip I (Philip the Handsome) (AD 1478–1506). In the late 16th century the shield was in the collection of Archduke Ferdinand II (AD 1529–95) at Ambras Castle near Innsbruck.
